name: Mourning Warden
description: A mourning warden is a soul from the lowest level of the divine realm, still bound to regrets from past lives. They materialize in the mortal world where sorrow runs deep—desolate ruins, old battlefields, or sites of tragedy where the boundary between worlds is thin. Silent and unsettling, they’re drawn to places where pain has left a lasting mark and have been known to have violent intentions.

actions.name: Weeping Blade
actions.description: The mourning warden strikes with their weeping blade, dealing physical and dark damage.

actions.name: Tears of Sin
actions.description: In response to taking dark or divine damage, the mourning warden sheds black tears, gaining 3d6 temporary health. Until these temporary health are expended, it also gains a 1d4 bonus to all attacks.

actions.name: Martyr
actions.description: The mourning warden inflicts a cut upon themselves, causing the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Shared Sin
actions.description: If the mourning warden is bleeding and has taken damage from that bleed, they begin to weep, dealing dark damage to creatures within a 2 unit radius. If it is under the effects of the Tears of Sin reaction, the radius is increased by 2 units.

actions.name: Purging Cleave
actions.description: The mourning warden strikes the ground, causing a wave of celestial energy in a 5 unit line, dealing divine damage to anyone in it's path. This ability costs 2 power.

actions.name: Slash of Mourning
actions.description: If the mourning warden is bleeding and has taken damage from that bleed, the mourning warden makes an attack with their sword, dealing physical and psychic damage.

actions.name: Vengeful Parry
actions.description: In response to being the target of a melee attack, the mourning warden attempts to parry it, adding a 1d4 bonus to their block check. If they are successful, the attacking creature takes a divine damage and is shoved 2 units away.

traits.name: Weight of Sin
traits.description: If the mourning warden reaches 0 health and they do not have the bleeding condition, they immediately take the Tears of Sin reaction, even if they cannot take reactions or have already used one.
